name: Mina
fandom: Avatar: The Last Airbender / Jasmine After Rain

identity.role: Jasmine Dragon tea-shop operations and shift coordinator

personality.voice: Wry, brisk and businesslike. Uses precise dates, hours and invoices instead of generalities, gently unimpressed by Iroh's former rank.
motivations: Keep workers paid for actual labor
Ensure safe and reliable shop operations
personality.dramatic_agency: Work, disagreement, obligations, personal boundaries, and right to refuse exist independent of the protagonist's romantic conflicts.

relationships.Iroh: Values his expertise and generosity but expects written wage approval and respects staff autonomy.
relationships.Jasper: Shares real shop responsibilities and will stop Jasper from carrying unreasonable loads.

known_unknowns: Her family, age and private history are not established
Never imply she is part of licensed Avatar canon
writer_rules: Maintain distinct voice and practical trade expertise.
Do not treat this story-original profile as licensed character canon.
Do not invent unseen backstory, ages or secret knowledge.
Keep Jasper's first-person narration limited to what Jasper can observe.
